description: This file defines a template class 'SingleClientServer' for managing a WebSocket server that handles a single client connection, including methods to start and stop the server, with logging and error handling.

classes.name: SingleClientServer
classes.description: A template class providing WebSocket server functionality for a single client, including start and stop methods, with callback support.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the WebSocket server on a specified port, setting up connection and closure callbacks, with error handling.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the WebSocket server listening process and closes existing connections, with logging.
